# TIMBERMEN TREE SERVICES

> Professional tree care and removal services serving Springfield, Missouri since 2021

Timbermen Tree Services is a licensed and insured tree care company serving Springfield, Missouri and surrounding communities. Certified arborists handle everything from routine pruning to hazardous removals — for both homes and businesses.

## Services

- Tree Removal: Safe removal of hazardous, unwanted, or storm-damaged trees.
- Pruning & Trimming: Structural pruning that keeps trees healthy, shapely, and clear of structures.
- Tree Health Care: Diagnosis and treatment to save trees worth saving.
- Wood Chipping & Debris Hauling: Full cleanup — the crew leaves the property tidy.
- Stump Grinding/Removal: Below-grade stump removal and replant-ready grading.
- Lot & Brush Clearing: Lot clearing and brush management for residential and commercial parcels.
- 24/7 Storm Response: Emergency storm-damage cleanup — see recent [storm damage work](https://timbermentrees.com/).

## About

Expert arborists providing professional tree care services for residential and commercial properties. Licensed, insured, and committed to safety and quality. Serving Springfield, Missouri since 2021.
